title: No Generation without Representation: Efficient Causal Protein Language Models Enable Zero-Shot Fitness Estimation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's predicted frequencies of specific amino acids (e.g., over-predicting serine and leucine) against their actual occurrence frequencies in the data, and using inverse logit lens techniques to identify amino acids the model actively suppresses (e.g., tryptophan and cysteine).

Averaging attention weights across protein sequences to measure the model's allocation of capacity, determining that it has a bias toward prioritizing distant positions (>20 residues away) over local positions.
